newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SHORT-TERM CALLS DOMINATE OPTIONS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: SHORT-TERM CALLS DOMINATE OPTIONS TRADE.

text.p: Trade in Hansapank options was biased in favour of short-term call options, reflecting the belief that stock prices were set to rise over the next month, dealers said.
Total options trade during the last week was around eight million kroons.
"It was an unusual week with short term spectulative calls in Hansapank and Uhispank for June and July attracting the most interest," Tonis Haavel, Hansapank's options trader told Reuters.
"Long-term buys were still there, but the interest was in short terms," he added.
Over recent weeks, long-term buy options have dominated trade with the assumption that stocks will not move again until autumn with little interest in short term calls.
However, with an active bourse expected over the next few days, interest in options trading during the coming week is expected to fall away.
"If the market continues to push higher, there will not be many deals done this week," he added.
